verdict.rationale: Moneybird is accounting and invoicing SaaS, not an AI agent or chat host. Consuming third-party MCP servers is the MCP-client role, which falls outside this product's category, and nothing in the pack shows an embedded assistant that could act as a client. The evidence only shows Moneybird exposing its own MCP server to external clients such as Claude, ChatGPT and Gemini. That is the server role, which cannot be credited to this client-side story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
